Your impact At Jacobs, we push the limits of what’s possible to make the world smarter, more connected, and more sustainable. We are a key delivery partner on one of Saudi Arabia’s flagship giga projects and a cornerstone of Vision 2030, helping to create world-class destinations that redefine entertainment, culture, and visitor experiences. About The Opportunity The AVL Project Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of Audio, Visual and Lighting (AVL) systems across major entertainment, cultural, and mixed-use developments. This role will lead the planning, coordination, design management, installation, integration, testing, commissioning, and handover of complex AVL packages, ensuring alignment with project objectives, technical requirements, programme milestones, budget constraints, and operational needs. Acting as the primary point of contact for all AVL-related matters, the AVL Project Manager will manage consultants, contractors, suppliers, and specialist engineers throughout the project lifecycle. The role requires a strong combination of technical AVL expertise, project management capability, stakeholder management skills, and construction delivery experience to successfully deliver world-class entertainment and immersive technology environments. The successful candidate will work closely with project leadership, design teams, construction teams, contractors, operators, and external stakeholders to ensure AVL systems are delivered safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards. Role Responsibilities Lead the full lifecycle delivery of AVL packages from design development through procurement, installation, commissioning, operational readiness, and final handover. Manage AVL package scope, programme, budget, risk, quality, and resource requirements throughout the project lifecycle. Develop, maintain, and monitor AVL delivery programmes, ensuring alignment with overall project milestones and construction schedules. Act as the primary technical authority and client representative for all AVL-related matters across the project. Manage and coordinate AVL design consultants, installation contractors, specialist suppliers, and system integrators. Review and oversee AVL design deliverables, technical submittals, shop drawings, equipment schedules, system schematics, and specifications. Coordinate AVL systems with architectural, structural, MEP, IT, networking, BMS, and show control disciplines to ensure seamless integration across all interfaces. Identify design, construction, commissioning, and operational risks, proactively developing mitigation strategies and driving issue resolution. Oversee AVL installation activities on site, ensuring works are delivered in accordance with approved designs, quality standards, project specifications, and programme requirements. Monitor contractor performance, installation progress, workforce productivity, and resource allocation, implementing corrective actions where required. Coordinate AVL activities with the wider construction team to manage interfaces and minimise programme impacts. Lead Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), integrated systems testing, commissioning activities, and operational readiness reviews. Oversee the preparation and review of operation and maintenance manuals, as-built documentation, training materials, and handover records. Manage project documentation including submittal logs, design registers, RFIs, quality records, commissioning documentation, risk registers, and project trackers. Ensure compliance with project quality standards through inspections, testing programmes, defect management, snagging, and close-out activities. Champion a strong health, safety, and wellbeing culture, ensuring compliance with site procedures, permit-to-work systems, risk assessments, and safe working practices. Prepare and present programme updates, risk reports, technical reviews, and project progress reports to senior leadership and key stakeholders. Build and maintain effective working relationships with consultants, contractors, operators, vendors, and project teams to support successful project outcomes. Support the development of team members through coaching, knowledge sharing, collaboration, and technical leadership. Here's what you'll need Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Audio Engineering, Acoustics, Systems Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline. Professional project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is preferred. Minimum 10 years of experience in AVL systems delivery, design, integration, installation, or project management within large-scale construction, entertainment, hospitality, cultural, or infrastructure projects. Demonstrated experience delivering AVL packages from design development through commissioning and handover on complex, multi-disciplinary projects. Strong technical knowledge of professional audio systems, video and display systems, LED technology, projection systems, architectural and theatrical lighting, media servers, show control systems, networking, and low-voltage infrastructure. Proven experience managing AVL consultants, contractors, suppliers, and commissioning teams across multiple concurrent workstreams. Strong understanding of AVL installation methodologies, testing procedures, commissioning processes, quality requirements, and operational readiness activities. Ability to review and interpret technical drawings, system schematics, wiring diagrams, rack elevations, equipment schedules, and commissioning documentation. Experience managing project programmes, budgets, risks, procurement activities, and stakeholder engagement throughout the project lifecycle. Knowledge of construction delivery processes and coordination requirements across architectural, structural, MEP, IT, and specialist systems packages. Experience using project management and document control platforms such as Aconex, Procore, or similar systems. Working knowledge of AutoCAD, Navisworks, BIM coordination processes, and Microsoft Office applications. Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. 0a6303398952f750.description: About MBRF MBRF is a company that impacts thousands of families globally by providing quality and innovation. The company focuses on nourishing life through its products and the contributions of its employees. The Role: Import and Logistics Analyst MBRF is seeking an Import and Logistics Analyst to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and involves managing import operations to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery of materials to the Jeddah factory. Key Responsibilities Coordinate import operations, customs clearance, and transportation activities to ensure timely delivery of materials to the Jeddah factory, minimizing delays and demurrage costs. Manage and verify import documentation, including invoices, packing lists, health, and HALAL certificates, ensuring compliance with customs regulations and internal procedures. Monitor purchase order conditions, supplier invoices, and logistics costs, ensuring accurate payment bookings, cost allocation, and alignment with contractual agreements. Analyze cost discrepancies, reconcile supplier statements of account (SOA) and outstanding provisions, and coordinate with Finance and Accounts Payable teams to resolve payment-related issues. Collaborate with suppliers, customs agents, transporters, 3PL providers, and internal teams to manage shipments, warehouse activities, and documentation requirements, including Jeddah and Dammam port operations. Maintain accurate operational records, proactively resolve shipment and documentation issues, and support continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with HSE and food safety standards. Required Skills and Competencies Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills. Excellent planning, organizational, and time management abilities. Effective communication and stakeholder management skills in a multicultural environment. Proactive, collaborative, and results-oriented mindset, with the ability to manage multiple priorities. Work Environment and Growth Opportunities MBRF offers a global, collaborative, and dynamic working environment. The company maintains a strong corporate culture with commitments to customers, employees, and the environment. Employees can expect vertical, horizontal, and cross-functional growth opportunities within the organization.

0a47757625877241.description: About Lucid Lucid is focused on creating mobility experiences through innovation in the automotive sector. The company develops vehicles based on proprietary technology and a software-defined architecture, emphasizing performance, sustainability, design, and engineering. Lucid's operations include in-house design, engineering, and production across global offices and manufacturing facilities, with teams from various industries contributing to its objectives. Role Overview The Senior Technician (Digital LV) supports ECU Manufacturing by executing technical tasks related to software-release readiness, ECU flashing, manufacturing testing, and sustaining production. This full-time role, based in Makkah, including King Abdullah Economic City, involves independent support for pre-release testing, maintenance of flashing tools and test-station computers, and resolution of technical issues affecting engineering builds and production rollout. The position requires 5-10 years of experience and applies advanced practical knowledge of electronics, Windows-based systems, wiring diagrams, harnesses, connectors, diagnostic interfaces, and electrical troubleshooting. Key Responsibilities Establish, maintain, and track ECU software releases for engineering builds and production. Act as the primary technician supporting users and coordinating software-release activities within the flashing area. Execute the in-house ECU software-release process with Manufacturing Test, Operations, and contract manufacturers. Collaborate with technical program managers, software engineers, and test engineers to implement and maintain release tools, processes, and supporting solutions. Provide software-file locations, flashing tools, traceability information, and related technical support for engineering builds and production. Communicate activities, risks, issues, and status for assigned programs to the responsible Test Engineer. Review, track, and support sign-off of software DEVREQs and ECRs for internal and external ECUs. Coordinate multiple concurrent releases, builds, and deployments from development through production rollout. Execute and track pre-release software testing in the Manufacturing Test laboratory, contract-manufacturer locations, and internal sites. Track open software and test-station issues, perform technical troubleshooting, and drive assigned actions to resolution. Inspect, troubleshoot, repair, and verify harnesses, connectors, wiring, and pinouts used in ECU flashing and test stations. Diagnose and resolve USB, Ethernet, serial, diagnostic-interface, and flashing-tool communication issues. Maintain test-station computers through Windows troubleshooting, software setup, driver installation, network-connectivity support, and peripheral configuration. Provide practical technical guidance to other technicians and users within the assigned scope when required. Required Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant technical role. Advanced practical knowledge of electronics and Windows-based systems. 0a97dcab187595f8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة اول النائفات للمقاولات عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل مسؤولية متابعة تطبيق لوائح السلامة والصحة المهنية، وإجراء التفتيش، والتحقيق في الحوادث، وإعداد التقارير اللازمة لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية والتعليمات المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية في المنشآت. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الدورية والطارئة في مواقع العمل وتسجيل النتائج ومقارنتها بالمعايير المعتمدة. تجهيز معدات وأجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية مثل درجة الحرارة والرطوبة والضجيج والاهتزاز، وتوثيق النتائج. متابعة معالجة الأخطار الناجمة عن العوامل البيئية مع الجهات المختصة. تحضير مستلزمات التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات، وإجراء التحقيق وتوثيق النتائج. إعداد تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتعليمات العمل الآمن والإخلاء، وتوعية العاملين بها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. معرفة قوية بالقوانين واللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على استخدام أجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية المختلفة. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والتوثيق. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل فعالة لشرح الإجراءات والتعليمات للعاملين. القدرة على التحقيق في الحوادث وتحليل الأسباب الجذرية. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في العمل. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في جازان، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزامًا بالعمل بدوام كامل. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

Key Responsibilities Receive customers and their vehicles in a professional manner. Open job cards with clear and detailed concerns, promoting additional services and products as appropriate. Raise vehicle job cards and pass them to workshop control for scheduling. Ensure all service documentation is completed accurately and customer records are maintained. Notify customers of problems or additional work required and obtain authorization to proceed. Keep customers informed of work progress, changes to costs, and expected completion times. Liaise effectively with customer booking, workshop loading, and parts operations. Receive completed job cards and vehicle invoices, ensuring all details are correct. Notify customers of vehicle completion, explain costs, and arrange vehicle release after payment. Manage work in progress, ensuring no outstanding items are over one month old without explanation. Handle cash debts and ensure no unauthorized credit facilities are extended. Ensure vehicles are released only with prior authority from the Reception or Service Manager and maintain records of vehicle release forms. Address customer complaints promptly and effectively, escalating unresolved issues to the immediate supervisor. Ensure all departmental administration is handled promptly and correctly according to guidelines. Required Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Previous technical and mechanical experience is preferred. Required Skills Strong customer-facing and telephone communication skills. Solid product knowledge. Good administration and organizational skills. Ability to work effectively within a team environment. IT literacy. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time Service Advisor position.

0a1df2ebbb1b5941.description: About MBRF MBRF is one of the world’s largest food companies, impacting thousands of families globally. The company focuses on nourishing life through quality, innovation, and its dedicated workforce. The Role of Production Supervisor MBRF is seeking a Production Supervisor to join its team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time position requires 5-10 years of experience and involves overseeing production operations to ensure quality, safety, and efficiency. Key Responsibilities Guarantee compliance with quality standards and procedures. Participate in decision-making for corrective and preventive actions within the Production Department. Plan, monitor, and evaluate job results; coach and discipline employees. Manage Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to assigned production line(s). Maintain a safe and clean work environment by educating and directing personnel on the use of control points, equipment, and resources. Ensure health and safety guidelines are implemented and followed within Production. Monitor the quality of incoming raw materials and finished products. Manage process and material flows, and work to maximize equipment utilization. Help develop, update, and maintain procedures and documentation for all Quality & Management Systems. Ensure employees are trained for their work and that training is documented. Escort audits within the sector and implement corrective actions in case of deviation. Focus on continuous process improvement, utilizing PDCA and other tools, and lead the process by connecting all necessary stakeholders, including equipment suppliers. Provide appropriate supervision. Identify risks and hazards arising from projects and activities. Prepare and implement identified control measures. Provide appropriate personal protective equipment to relevant personnel. Qualifications and Experience Graduation in Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Production Engineering, or related fields. 5-10 years of relevant experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Eastern region, within a dynamic food production environment.

0a595f94aa815c49.description: About the Role First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB) is seeking an Assistant Vice President (AVP) Corporate Governance / Board Secretary for FAB Capital in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for supporting the Board and its Committees, performing the Board secretariat function, and maintaining the Corporate Governance Policy of FAB Capital KSA. The AVP ensures compliance with applicable governance and regulatory requirements, acts as Board Secretary, and serves as a trusted governance adviser to the Chair, Board Members, and Senior Management. Role Context and Reporting As the designated Board Secretary for FAB Capital KSA, this position operates within the governance arrangements of the regulated entity. The role reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer of FAB Capital KSA and has a functional reporting line to the Group Head of Corporate Governance, FAB Group. This structure ensures alignment with Group Corporate Governance standards and practices and supports effective Board governance, local regulatory compliance, and FAB Group governance standards. Key Responsibilities Support the CEO and Group Head of Corporate Governance in maintaining an effective governance framework for FAB Capital KSA. Act as Board Secretary to the Board and its Committees, including agenda planning, meeting administration, minute-taking, decision recording, and action follow-up. Prepare and circulate meeting notices, agendas, and supporting materials within required timeframes. Maintain complete and secure records of Board and Board Committee papers, minutes, resolutions, and attendance. Coordinate the execution, certification, filing, and communication of Board and Board Committee resolutions and decisions. Prepare the Company’s Corporate Governance disclosures and Annual CG Report, ensuring alignment with international standards. Provide governance support for corporate transactions, new activities, regulatory reviews, audits, and special projects affecting FAB Capital KSA. Monitor and assess changes to applicable Saudi laws, regulations, and governance requirements, recommending updates to governance arrangements. Administer annual self-assessment questionnaires for the Board, Board Committees, and Management Committees. Act as the designated backup for the Head of Compliance during periods of absence, ensuring continuity of regulatory obligations and reporting. Deliver governance-related training and awareness sessions for staff and Board members. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Corporate Governance, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline. Minimum 7–10 years of experience in corporate governance, company secretarial, legal, or regulatory roles within financial services or other regulated environments, with a focus on Board and executive-level committees. Fluent in English and/or Arabic, with highly developed written and verbal communication skills. Demonstrated experience supporting Boards and Board Committees. Strong understanding of governance requirements applicable to regulated financial institutions. Experience interacting with regulators and senior executives. Knowledge of the Saudi Companies Law and governance requirements applicable to FAB Capital KSA. Demonstrated experience independently managing the full Board and Board Committee secretariat cycle. Professional governance or company secretarial qualifications are preferred. Required Skills Strong interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to lead, coach, and motivate colleagues. Collaborative team player capable of meeting tight deadlines and managing a challenging workload. Strong ethics and integrity, with the ability to manage market-sensitive and highly confidential information responsibly. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and may require travel to other FAB locations as needed. The role involves close collaboration with the Chair, Board and Board Committee members, CEO, and Senior Management of FAB Capital KSA, while maintaining a functional relationship with Group Corporate Governance in the UAE.

0ac1be007562a368.description: About AFRY AFRY is an international engineering, design, and advisory company. The company supports clients in sustainability and digitalization with a team of 19,000 experts across infrastructure, industry, and energy sectors globally. AFRY focuses on creating sustainable solutions for future generations. Role Overview AFRY is seeking a Payroll and People Operations Specialist to support its growing business in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves delivering accurate and compliant payroll and HR operational services throughout the employee lifecycle. The specialist will ensure adherence to Saudi labor legislation, payroll regulations, and company policies, working closely with employees, managers, Finance, external payroll providers, and the EMEA People Operations team. Key Responsibilities Coordinate and support monthly payroll processing, including administration through external providers like Mawarit. Collect, review, and validate payroll inputs such as new hires, terminations, salary changes, bonuses, allowances, overtime, leave data, and final settlements. Process employee leave transactions and maintain accurate leave balance calculations and records. Coordinate monthly personnel expense reimbursements and ensure timely payroll-related payments. Review payroll reports for accuracy prior to approval and submission. Respond to payroll-related queries from employees and managers, resolving issues promptly. Ensure compliance with local payroll legislation, statutory requirements, and GOSI regulations. Maintain payroll documentation and records, including employee updates within the GOSI portal. Coordinate employee medical insurance enrolments, amendments, and terminations with relevant providers. Support annual salary review and bonus administration processes. Monitor payroll deadlines and ensure all payroll activities are completed accurately and on time. Follow up on payroll-related invoices and partner with Finance and payroll vendors to resolve discrepancies and improve processes. Manage employee lifecycle activities including onboarding, employment contracts, employee data changes, promotions, transfers, and offboarding. Coordinate employee transfers and onboarding activities with external partners, including Mawarit where applicable. Support visa administration, including exit/re-entry visa arrangements, Iqama renewals, and other employee mobility requirements. Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems. Support compliance with Saudi labor law and internal policies. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and operational excellence across HR processes. Act as a point of contact for employees and managers on HR operational matters. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience. The role requires a proactive, detail-oriented, and service-oriented individual with a strong understanding of Saudi labor legislation and payroll regulations. Work Environment and Impact This position offers an opportunity to join a collaborative international team, contributing to payroll and HR operational services that support employees and business success. The role provides broad exposure across the organization, involving partnerships with employees, managers, Finance, and external providers. As the business grows, the specialist will have the opportunity to help shape processes and drive operational excellence within a dynamic environment. Application Information AFRY is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply, irrespective of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, disability, or age. The company values diversity and aims to accelerate the transition towards a sustainable society.

0a0df2e4e1d26ace.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صالح مطر صالح الزهراني للصيانة والنظافة عن فني مونتاج للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية تجهيز وتنفيذ مونتاج الأعمال الفنية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تجهيز معدات وأجهزة المونتاج اللازمة لقص ولحام الوصلات. دراسة لقطات المشاهد والتسجيلات الصوتية وترتيبها وفقاً لتسلسل أحداث ومشاهد العمل الفني. قص ولحام اللقطات المصورة وتجميعها وتوصيلها لإنشاء المنتج النهائي. مراجعة وتدقيق تسلسل الأحداث والمشاهد في النسخة الممنتجة، وإعادة تصوير اللقطات على أشرطة مستمرة عند الحاجة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المونتاج أو ما يعادله. القدرة على استخدام معدات وأجهزة المونتاج المختلفة بكفاءة. فهم جيد لأسس السرد البصري والسمعي في الأعمال الفنية. المهارات الشخصية دقة الملاحظة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل لضمان جودة المونتاج. مهارات تنظيمية جيدة لإدارة اللقطات والتقارير. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة عمل داعمة تركز على إنجاز الأعمال الفنية بجودة عالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. نشجع المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة على التقديم.

0a192ea8a7d86c48.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات عن مدير أشغال ومرافق عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الأحساء. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أنشطة إدارة المرافق، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية الحالية والمستقبلية، والتصاميم، والأثاث، بالإضافة إلى جداول أعمال الصيانة والتنظيف. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الخطط والسياسات والاستراتيجيات الإدارية العامة لمرافق الشركة والإشراف على تنفيذها. ضمان الالتزام بقواعد ولوائح الصحة والسلامة والبيئة ومباشرة تنفيذها. مباشرة الأنشطة اليومية للمرافق، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية والتصاميم والأثاث. تخطيط الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمرافق. مباشرة أنشطة الصيانة وتنسيق عمليات التصليح مع تقليل مدة التوقف عن العمل. اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم، ومراقبة أدائهم وسلوكهم مقارنةً بالأهداف. تخطيط أعمال الإنشاء والملحقات الجديدة، وإعداد العقود المتعلقة بالبناء ومراجعتها والموافقة عليها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بإدارة المرافق أو الأشغال العامة. القدرة على تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أنشطة إدارة المرافق بكفاءة. فهم جيد لمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة في مشروع نظافة وصيانة وتشغيل المدينة السكنية بمنفذ الربع الخالي. يتطلب الدور التواجد بدوام كامل في الموقع. معلومات إضافية تعتبر هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل متخصص في مشروع حيوي بالمنطقة الشرقية. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب في الوقت الحالي. التقديم للمهتمين بالتقديم على وظيفة مدير أشغال ومرافق عامة، يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية.

0a32984a94682fe1.description: About CD Horizon Arabia Company Ltd CD Horizon Arabia Company Ltd is actively seeking an AWP Service Engineer to join its heavy equipment maintenance department. As a subsidiary of Far East Horizon (******, Horizon Construction Development Limited ("CDHORIZON") is a prominent equipment rental company in China, offering comprehensive "product+service" solutions to clients in the construction and industrial sectors. Established in 2011, CDHORIZON ranks 11th in the IRN100 (2025) and operates an integrated network of over 560 rental locations, serving over 400,000 clients in China and internationally. In 2023, CDHORIZON was listed on the main board of Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX). The company maintains a continuous investment in R&D and innovation, engaging in strategic collaborations with leading domestic and international equipment manufacturers, universities, and research institutes. It holds hundreds of patents and intellectual property rights, with two of its subsidiaries recognized as "National High-tech Enterprises." Role Overview The AWP Service Engineer will be responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of Aerial Work Platform (AWP) equipment. This full-time position is available in Dammam and Riyadh and requires a professional with 5-10 years of relevant experience in heavy equipment maintenance. Key Responsibilities Conduct preventive maintenance and routine inspections of AWP equipment. Perform detailed inspections on equipment to identify indications of wear and tear. Install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair equipment and machinery. Read and apply circuit diagrams for repair, maintenance, and troubleshooting tasks. Provide technical support to customers and internal teams. Document all service activities and maintain accurate records of maintenance and repairs performed. Ensure compliance with safety standards and company policies during all operations. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in either Dammam or Riyadh. The role involves working within the heavy equipment maintenance department, contributing to the operational efficiency of CD Horizon Arabia Company Ltd. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified experience requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

0af4417fd08c1c99.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Supervisor Systems /IT to join their team in Makkah, with operations extending to Jeddah. This full-time role involves overseeing and managing IT systems and providing technical support to ensure smooth operations within the hospitality environment. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Troubleshoot and resolve technical problems related to computer software and systems. Provide technical guidance and recommendations to address business problems. Analyze, recommend, and implement process improvements for IT systems. Operate computer and peripheral equipment, including entering commands and activating controls. Troubleshoot, modify, support, manage, and maintain application programs and user accounts. Maintain records of daily data communication transactions, problems, remedial actions, and installation activities. Train users in the proper use of hardware and software. Manage and coordinate planning, design, operations, maintenance, and resource allocation for telecommunications activities, including client/server support. Advise on administrative policies, procedures, technical problems, priorities, and methods related to telecommunications. Leadership and Operational Support Assist management with hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees. Serve as a role model and initial point of contact for the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Foster positive working relationships and support team goals. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Identify, recommend, develop, and implement new methods to enhance organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and cost-savings. Required Qualifications 2-5 years of experience in systems or IT support. Proficiency in troubleshooting software and system issues. Ability to enter and locate information using computers and Point of Sale (POS) systems. Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, for professional interactions. Ability to follow company policies and procedures and protect company assets. Capable of moving, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, and placing objects weighing up to 10 pounds without assistance. About Marriott International Marriott International is a global leader in hospitality, with a portfolio of diverse brands. Marriott Hotels are committed to delivering "Wonderful Hospitality. Always." by providing thoughtful, heartfelt, and forward-thinking service. JW Marriott, part of the luxury portfolio, operates over 100 properties worldwide and emphasizes associate well-being, believing that happy associates lead to happy guests. Joining Marriott International means becoming part of a global team dedicated to professional growth and purpose. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to contribute to a leading hospitality brand in Makkah and Jeddah.

0afd6b3389ceee6d.description: About Madi International Madi International is seeking a Project Executive to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time, onsite position focused on driving sales opportunities and supporting existing client relationships within the beauty and salon sector. Role Overview The Project Executive will be responsible for engaging with new projects to generate sales and revenue growth. The role also involves supporting existing salons through renovation projects, sales closures, and achieving collection targets. This position plays a key role in converting project leads into actual revenue. Key Responsibilities Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the beauty and salon sector to drive sales growth. Visit existing salons to assess renovation opportunities, suggest improvements, and maintain strong client relationships. Lead client meetings to present project proposals, negotiate terms, and close sales deals. Ensure timely collection of payments from clients and work towards achieving monthly collection targets. Collaborate with internal teams to develop tailored solutions and projects for clients. Prepare sales and collection reports for management review. Stay informed about industry trends and competitive activities to recommend innovative beauty project solutions. Compensation and Benefits Competitive base salary with an attractive commission structure. Comprehensive health insurance plan. Opportunities for professional development and training. Employee discounts on beauty and salon products and services. Supportive team environment with clear career advancement paths. Pleasant and modern work atmosphere. Work Environment This role is based onsite in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves working as part of a dynamic team focused on client engagement and sales within the beauty and salon industry.

0a07141172a2a83e.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع الميدان الدولي لطب وتقويم الأسنان عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقه في خميس مشيط، عسير. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تشخيص وعلاج أمراض الفم والأسنان، بالإضافة إلى متابعة التركيبات السنية وإجراء الجراحات الصغرى. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص الشامل لأسنان المرضى، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة وتحليلها لتشخيص الحالات المرضية للفم والأسنان. إعداد خطة العلاج وبرنامجها الزمني، وتنفيذ المعالجات السنية مثل الحشوات ومعالجة القنوات اللبية. تنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية، وتحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية وأخذ القياسات اللازمة. متابعة تنفيذ وتركيب التعويضات السنية وضبطها لضمان فعاليتها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى. وصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة للحالات المرضية المختلفة. إعداد وتوثيق التقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وتقديم الرعاية اللازمة. بيئة العمل يعمل طبيب الأسنان العام ضمن فريق مجمع الميدان الدولي لطب وتقويم الأسنان في مدينة خميس مشيط. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى. تطوير الأداء المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل داخل المجمع. مواكبة أحدث التطورات والتقنيات في مجال طب الأسنان لضمان تقديم أفضل الخدمات. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. نشجع المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة على التقديم.

0a5a3bd11da1b7ec.description: About Noon Noon is building an ecosystem of digital products and services designed to power everyday life across the Middle East. The company focuses on fast, scalable, and customer-centric solutions, with a mission to deliver to every door every day. Noon Minutes, the hyper-local delivery platform, offers FMCG and grocery products with delivery within 15 minutes, currently operating in the UAE and Saudi Arabia. The Role of CCTV Operator Noon is seeking a CCTV Operator to join the team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of experience. The primary responsibility of this role is to monitor surveillance systems, identify and report security incidents, and contribute to maintaining a safe, secure, and efficient operating environment for people, assets, and operations. Key Responsibilities Monitor CCTV cameras and surveillance systems to detect and respond to security or safety incidents. Continuously observe live camera feeds and report suspicious activities, unauthorized access, or operational concerns. Record, document, and escalate incidents in accordance with company procedures. Retrieve and review CCTV footage to support investigations and internal requests. Ensure all surveillance equipment is operational and promptly report any faults or technical issues. Coordinate with Security, Operations, and relevant stakeholders during incidents or emergencies. Maintain accurate logs, incident reports, and surveillance records. Ensure confidentiality and secure handling of surveillance footage and sensitive information. Support compliance with company security policies and local regulations. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will possess high standards and understand the importance of diligent work.
